_comment_where: Copy to the path the app resolves, then edit. That path is $SPOTIFY_CONFIG when set, otherwise platformdirs' user_config_dir('spotify-mcp')/config.json. `spotify-mcp config` prints the resolved one. For a dev checkout use SPOTIFY_CONFIG=./dev.config.json — its data lands in ./data beside it, so a checkout cannot read or write the database a packaged install uses.
_comment_who_writes: The desktop app owns this file (apps/tauri/src-tauri/src/config.rs). Python only reads it. Editing by hand is fine; two writers is what produced divergent config files before.
_comment_unknown_keys: Unknown keys are preserved on write, so a newer build's settings survive an older build reading and rewriting the file.
_comment_spotify: Both set from the app's Setup page. TOKEN_ENCRYPT_KEY is generated on first open and must never be regenerated — every token already encrypted with the old key becomes permanently unreadable. Back this file up.
_comment_worker: Written by the Cloudflare deploy. WORKER_AUTH_TOKEN exists nowhere else — Cloudflare secrets are write-only — so this file is its only backup.
_comment_history_db: Optional. Defaults to <data dir>/history.db. A relative value resolves against the data dir, not the cwd, so it does not depend on where the app was launched from.
_comment_llm: Optional, for AI reports. Only Gemini and OpenAI are wired up; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not supported yet.
_comment_tracing: Optional. Langfuse needs all three keys or none. LangSmith needs LANGSMITH_TRACING=true as well as the key; set LANGSMITH_ENDPOINT only if your region differs from the default.
